direction.grid: 100vw x 100dvh overflow:hidden; rows 48px header / 52px guide / minmax(0,1fr) main / 56px action bar; columns 184px rail / minmax(0,1fr) stage / 360px inspector at 1366x768; stage at least 55vw x 60vh; no page scroll, internal scroll only in inspector and task lists; targets at least 36px; refit tight panels before reducing type
direction.colorTokens: bg #050705, panel #0B100B, raised #121A12, silver #C5CCD4 for headings and machine bodies, silverDim rgba(197,204,212,.68), border rgba(197,204,212,.22); primary neon #A8F04A with #050705 text, one primary per viewport; stoppedRed #E5484D reserved exclusively for stopped CELL-MILL-2 outline, cross-hatch and OFFLINE-STOPPED text; official logo immutable black, emerald/neon green and brushed silver at native aspect in exactly two placements: header and opening story, never recolored, cropped, redrawn or duplicated elsewhere
direction.typography: System sans; 24/30 stage title, 15/20 panel title, 13/19 body, 11/14 uppercase micro-labels, 26px tabular metrics; one verb-led instruction and one status sentence per step; minimal narration; enlarge any stage label under 11px to 11px minimum
direction.motion: 160-220ms ease-out for selection and panels; one 240ms route trace on real state change, then static; no loops or pulses; prefers-reduced-motion removes transitions while pattern, marker and text still carry meaning; 2px neon focus ring with 2px offset on every interactive element; pointer style only on enabled controls
direction.components: Header 48px with official logo left and Lock recovery room right; opening story carries the second and final logo placement; step rail from one steps array with aria-current, arrow-key movement and 36-40px targets; guide strip 52px with no duplicate primary; focusable cinematic factory stage SVG; inspector 360px keeping pre-flight route-health checks for nonce and identity visually and semantically separate from the distinct investigation evidence task, with separate headings, status and controls; action bar 56px with Back left, status centre and one primary right; selecting a recovery option opens the typed consent form; skip-to-stage first, then header, rail, guide, SVG nodes, inspector and action bar in tab order; Enter/Space activate, Esc closes, aria-live polite announces results only
direction.visualizations: State-driven 960x540 SVG using real state only: MAT-ALLOY-A held, 40+30=70 units, feasible routes only in neon, silver for idle machines, red only for stopped CELL-MILL-2, never a route through the offline cell; aligned Certificate 120 versus Receiving 80 tracks with DOES NOT MATCH spanning the gap; bidirectional SVG-to-inspector highlighting; persistent Running/Held/Blocked/Offline-Stopped/Feasible-Accepted legend using pattern, marker and text; pending task proposals deliberately untracked until human approval, while blocked prior tasks remain visible beside an approved recovery plan as replacement tasks await approval

fixes.change: Enlarge DOES NOT MATCH and 120/80 gap labels to 13px and align both tracks on one baseline so the mismatch reads at stage distance.
Add bidirectional highlight: focusing ev-cert-qty or ev-recv-qty in inspector outlines the matching SVG track and machine with a 2px neon focus ring.
Reduce right inspector card text density; cap evidence cards to two lines plus source line to protect 1366x768 fit without scrolling the stage.
Visually separate ROUTE HEALTH PRE-FLIGHT nonce/identity panel from INVESTIGATION SOURCE EVIDENCE panel with distinct headings, borders and status icons; never share one control group.
Enlarge ev-cert-qty, ev-recv-qty and ev-sub-stock labels under the option cards to 11px minimum and add text markers, not colour alone.
Shorten the bottom inspector sentence to one status line so Run Sample investigation remains visible without inspector scroll at 768px.
Keep feasible path selected state and typed consent form linked: show Selected path chip inside the HUMAN DECISION panel directly above the exact phrase input.
Add character-match feedback with pattern and text, not colour alone, and keep Accept disabled until 27/27 exact match as shown.
Compress option card vertical padding by 4px so all three paths and the consent input fit the inspector without internal scroll.
Make t1/t2/t3 stage tabs full task titles at 12px instead of bare t1, t2, t3 so keyboard and screen-reader users can distinguish proposed tasks.
Label the dashed proposal region PROPOSED - UNTRACKED UNTIL APPROVAL in both stage and inspector, and keep task count 3 PROPOSED consistent in both places.
Enlarge the 1/2/3 proposal pager targets to 40px with visible focus ring and aria-labels naming each proposed task.
Strengthen the preview state for CELL-MILL-2: add PREVIEW - WILL GO OFFLINE text plus hatch pattern inside the SVG node before Apply is pressed, distinct from the later solid red stopped state.
Move the 24h to 0h capacity delta adjacent to CELL-MILL-2 in the SVG with an arrow and text label so the shock is understood from the stage alone.
Shorten inspector scenario copy to two lines; keep Apply second shock as the sole primary in the action bar.
Preserve red exclusively on stopped CELL-MILL-2: give STOPPED cross-hatch, red outline and OFFLINE-STOPPED text, while RECEIVING HOLD uses silver/neon held pattern instead of red tint.
Keep pre-flight nonce/identity checks separate from the investigation evidence task, with Reinvestigate recovery enabled only from the investigation control, not the route-health panel.
Mark Split available capacity as CONSTRAINED with hatch and text in the SVG strip, matching its inspector status after the second shock.
Retain fresh typed acceptance for the revised plan: show PRIOR ACCEPTANCE INVALIDATED beside the empty phrase field and keep Accept revised decision disabled until exact match.
Add a one-line delta summary in the inspector: 3 to 2 feasible paths, CELL-MILL-2 offline, Split constrained, so the revision reason is explicit.
Give the constrained Split card a non-interactive treatment with pointer style removed and aria-disabled, while keeping its explanation readable.
Keep 3 BLOCKED prior tasks visually separate from 3 PROPOSED replacements: use two labelled groups with different patterns in both stage header and inspector list.
Replace bare t1/t2/t3 stage tabs with short task titles and due/owner text at 11px minimum, matching the inspector proposal cards.
Ensure Approve revised tasks states the coexistence plainly in the action bar: Approved revised plan - replacement tasks await approval.
Sequence the three proof cards with numbered state text READY, LOCKED, LOCKED and connect them to inspector steps 1 Verify ledger, 2 Seal encrypted packet, 3 Retain independent checkpoint.
Enlarge passphrase guidance to 12px and show length/type checklist as text markers that update without colour alone.
Refit inspector spacing so Verify ledger primary, passphrase field and checkpoint control are all reachable by internal scroll with the action bar primary unchanged.
Restore the full factory SVG on the completion screen at the same scale as earlier steps, keeping red stopped CELL-MILL-2 and the sealed 18-event chain legible within 768px height.
Replace the empty Back-only action bar centre with a concise sealed status and add one clear exit or Lock recovery room action as the sole primary.
Mark all three retained-evidence steps Complete with check, text and pattern in the inspector, and announce completion once via aria-live polite.
